span.p:
Boss.write_baseline_osw
start the baseline OSW build

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. Reader
get_hvac_systems_xml
read HVACSystems from BuildingSync

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. HvacTopologySelector
one status per Delivery / OtherHVACSystem
classify each HVAC record; match it to a measure

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. BaselineHvacPlanner
skip proposed systems; all must match;
one conditioning + optional ventilation
decide L200 topology or L100 fallback

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4. HvacTargetBinder
whole-building premises → all model zones
apply each measure to all model zones

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
5a. L200 OSW: add_hvac = false
+ conditioning, ventilation, sizing steps
build the audited HVAC system

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
5b. L100 OSW (generic HVAC workflow):
add_hvac = true
+ one warning per reason
fall back to L100 generic HVAC, log why

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
6. Write in.osw and run OpenStudio
simulate the baseline
